author: Posighdun
body:
Please use the following format when writing a question on the "Ask the Seniors" subform.

Title: Needs to be your question

In the thread;
Who you want to address the question (Can be addressed by a whole group or one specific Senior Staff member);
Question;

Try to be as detailed as possible and the question must be anything Avicus related, within reason. Abusing this subform will get you a temporary website ban. 

- Posighdun
